# GitHub profile project visibility

This checklist controls **only the generated project tiles** in the profile README.
It does not delete, archive, or change the visibility of a GitHub repository.

- **Checked `[x]` = hide that repository from the README.**
- **Unchecked `[ ]` = allow it to appear.**
- Newly created public, nonempty, non-fork repositories appear automatically
  unless you add their exact repository name here and check it.
- The three illustrated projects remain visible unless you check them here.

## Hidden from the README

- [x] `pfsinterns`
- [x] `Heart-Disease-Prediction`
- [x] `Credit-EDA-Case-Study`
- [x] `Tweets-Generation-NLP`

## Example (not active)

To hide another repository, add a new line like `- [x] \`repository-name\``
above this heading. To show one again, change `[x]` to `[ ]`.
